name: Center Day Camp
description_short: Jewish community day camp on Sebago Basin in Windham, Maine, for grades 1 to 9, founded in 1949. Two four-week sessions plus an Art Adventures week, with boating, swim lessons, sports, arts, mountain biking and Israeli culture; buses from stops around the area.

sources.note: 2026 family handbook: buses to stops, families pack lunch and two snacks, operated by the Jewish Community Alliance
